title: Social Intelligence Data Infrastructure: Structuring the Present and Navigating the Future
reasoning: The paper includes 'Moral Value' and 'Social and Moral Norms' as core components of its 'Situational Intelligence' pillar within the proposed Social AI Taxonomy. Furthermore, the researchers explicitly benchmark various Large Language Models (LLMs) on their ability to perform situational judgment and moral exception reasoning using datasets such as NormBank and MoralExceptQA.
